joints.handle_description: No handle; lid rim sits flush with the jar body with no undercut for a fingertip; wire clamp at the free edge holds it shut.
joints.height_concern: lid edge ~0.17 m above object base

object_note: Clip-top jar. F is at the correct free edge but the lid does not overhang the body, so nothing to pinch; heuristic 'ungraspable' agrees. Lid flips up about rear hinge.
